items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: we were so spoiled by Ronny Zito and Jimmy Wormworth and Grogan that we were just wow... That can’t be the Catatonic Five because they always have good drummers.

ctx.x: That’s a great feeling. I had a similar circumstance when I was actually in my rock & roll days, my parents would come out and support the band even though it probably wasn’t their cup of tea. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

In fact there’s a funny story about that that sort of goes along with the other stuff we were talking about, that as I said we always had these spectacular drummers except one night all three of them couldn’t make it. We had a gig at Hobart. And so they suggested this other high school kid. So I mean we were so spoiled by Ronny Zito and Jimmy Wormworth and Grogan that we were just wow, this guy’s probably just as good. Well we got out there and he was just dreadful, he was awful. And I felt badly for him because…
I’ll be darned, they never even found you, they just said no that wasn’t us.
